انحجبت (form VII)
# اِنْحَجَبْتُ (inḥajabtu) /in.ħa.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# اِنْحَجَبْتَ (inḥajabta) /in.ħa.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# اِنْحَجَبْتِ (inḥajabti) /in.ħa.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# اِنْحَجَبَتْ (inḥajabat) /in.ħa.d͡ʒa.bat/: thir
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
